It's been a long time since I made a comic and this time I tried doing so using NovelAI's new comic functionality. There's definitely some drawbacks to it, especially when it comes to style consistency, but it's still very impressive give I did almost no post-editing of this myself.

You can see more comics like these as well as extra bonus images for this one for FREE on my Pixiv:
https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/85693219

You can also support me on Kofi if you feel like pitching in. I lock no content behind a paywall. This is simply a way for people to show support that want to: https://ko-fi.com/morbintsf

You can also contact me in those locations about a commission request or on my Twitter: https://x.com/MorbinTSF
